sentences.japanese: 私の目は夢を反映する海である。
sentences.english: My eyes are an ocean in which my dreams are reflected.

sentences.japanese: 私は海の近くに住んでいるのでよく海岸に行きます。
sentences.english: I live near the sea, so I often get to go to the beach.

sentences.japanese: 君と一緒に海に行きたいのですが。
sentences.english: I'd like to go to the seaside with you.

sentences.japanese: 君たちが海へ行くなら、僕も仲間に入れてくれ。
sentences.english: If you're going to the beach, count me in.

sentences.japanese: 空の旅は早いが海はおちつく。
sentences.english: Air travel is fast; sea travel is, however, restful.
